frame.stacking: not stackable: stepped terraces, the bolts stand above the rims

space.unity: prefab space, origin on the floor at the centre of the footprint, +z front, +y up, +x to the furniture's left seen from the front

groups.rows: g = 4 * row + column; row 0 is the front, column 0 the left seen from the front; each row stands 0.12 m higher than the one in front
groups.rule: Homes store: each group's units carry 'item', the bolt kind its cell is for (the two spares have none, only 'example_item'). One layout serves all sixteen cells, packed against all 14 models, so a kind that fills its home may take an empty cell (the spares first) without a copy touching another or the frame.

band_note: paint colour per kind: a painted slab on the rim of the cell's front wall and a band on that wall's face; paint swatches 0-15 in the atlas (u 64 + 4 k, v 32); the spares are chalk white and silver grey
fill_order: units are listed cell by cell; step 0 is the core bundle (the middle of the cell), steps 1-3 stand round it
position: unit position = mean of its copies' feet, on the floor of its cell (row j: y [0.185, 0.305, 0.425, 0.545]); box informational
copy_rule: bolts: align (long axis -> up, thin axis -> x), then_rotate = a lean of 1-5 degrees times a spin about the shaft, fit_longest_m 0.32, anchor bottom, offset.y = the foot height in the straw (0 .. 0.08 in steps) plus the lift a lean needs (a leaning copy dips below its bounds)
straw: every cell is packed with straw to 0.11 m over its floor; the straw surface is part of the frame, each triangle that any copy of any model touches cut away

heads.note: Align.Axes turns the item's +long axis to up and the models differ in sign, so the end that stands up is per model; spread = the widest radius of the top and bottom 7 cm of the standing bolt (the wide end is the fletching)

layout.one layout: the same sixteen copies in every cell, turned by a multiple of 90 degrees per cell

items.needle: VABoltNeedle's two blend feather quads count where their texture alpha is above 0.5 in the checks

checks.method: mesh against mesh (BVH): every copy of every one of the 14 models against the frame (straw included) and against every other copy in its cell; the full fill also across cells, the spares holding each kind in turn, and each kind in all sixteen cells at once.
